text: US dollar hits 18-month low at Vietnamese banks
HÀ NỘI - The State Bank of Vietnam (SBV) set the daily reference exchange rate at VNĐ25,623 buying a US dollar on November 5, down VNĐ4 from the previous session.
With the current trading band of ±5 per cent, the ceiling rate applicable to commercial banks stood at VNĐ26,904 buying a US dollar, while the floor rate was VNĐ24,342.
Notably, the US dollar has fallen to its lowest level at Vietnamese banks in 18 months.
The opening-hour exchange rates at major commercial banks saw decreases.
At 8:15 am, Vietcombank listed buying and selling rates at 25,510 VNĐD/USD and 25,890 VNĐ/USD, both down VNĐ70 from the November 4 morning session.
Similarly, BIDV also cut its respective rates by VNĐ65 to 25,510 VNĐ/USD and 25,890 VNĐ/USD. - VNA/VNS
